# Lucide brain fallback

`brain.svg` and the identical paths in `public/js/brain-fallback.js` are from
Lucide Icons and Contributors, under the ISC license in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934/icons/brain.svg

Pinned revision: `70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934`.

NOX adapts only stroke color, thickness, scale and glow; the paths remain
unchanged. The vector is the immediate, offline and lost-WebGL fallback for
the anatomical Signal renderer.
